title: WHO IRIS — Institutional Repository for Information Sharing
nodeKind: repository item (a record plus its bitstream bundles)

identifiers.name: DSpace UUID
identifiers.note: The source's OWN identifier, in the item URL. Stable while this DSpace instance is, and no longer — it is not guaranteed by anything outside IRIS.

identifiers.name: Handle
identifiers.note: Guaranteed by the Handle System, outside WHO. The identifier to resolve by, and the one that survives the source moving. The worked item carries TWO — the second, 10665.1/14518 on iris.wpro.who.int, is a regional instance that was merged into the global one, which is why repeated dc.identifier.uri values are never deduplicated.

identifiers.name: WHO govdoc number
identifiers.note: WHO's own publication number. The library slug in folio-assistant (`wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng`) is derived from THIS — the weakest of the three, so a tool resolving by slug is resolving by the weakest key available.

enumeration.method: DSpace 7 REST: /server/api/discover/search/objects, paged, filterable by dsoType, scope (a community or collection UUID) and facets. Communities are listed at /community-list. NOT EXERCISED FROM THIS ENVIRONMENT: iris.who.int is egress-blocked here (CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403), the same block bean r1lz recorded on 2026-09-19, so this method is read off DSpace 7's documented API and the site's own navigation rather than from a successful call.
enumeration.basis: iris.who.int storage report, By Location, Entire Site, read 2026-09-20: 'Nb of files: 1,057,223', 'Storage used: 361.55 GB', 'Nb of top-level communities: 8'. THIS IS A FILE COUNT, NOT AN ITEM COUNT — DSpace groups bitstreams into bundles (ORIGINAL, TEXT, THUMBNAIL, LICENSE) and an item carries several, so the true item count is smaller by roughly that factor and IRIS does not publish it. Recorded as-measured and labelled, because a guessed item count would be worse than a labelled wrong one. enumerationCost() therefore OVERSTATES, which is the safe direction for a size gate.

character.basis: remote and large: measured from its own storage report, 1,057,223 files / 361.55 GB / 8 communities, 2026-09-20. volatility `revised`: DSpace items are corrected in place and the worked record carries TWO dc.date.accessioned and TWO dc.date.available values for one item, which is that happening -- but handles are persistent and new editions get new items, so it is not `volatile`. availability `blocked`: measured, not assumed -- curl to iris.who.int from this environment returns CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403, the same block bean r1lz recorded on 2026-09-19. hasOwnSearch: the site's own navigation carries Browse IRIS and a search control.
